visual.general_description: Two-panel axial head imaging figure: grayscale contrast-enhanced CT (A) and color-fused PET/CT (B).
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a grayscale axial CT slice through the face and skull base with no marks on it; panel B is a color-fused PET/CT slice at a similar level with a rounded intense uptake focus on the image-right lateral face plus other uptake regions posteriorly and at the nose tip. Panel letters are the only text.

panels.general_description: Grayscale axial contrast-enhanced-appearing CT slice of the face and skull base.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial CT slice through the face and skull base. The nasal cavity with its septum and both maxillary sinuses appear as black air spaces; bright cortical bone surrounds the posterior fossa, which contains two rounded gray regions of the posterior cranial contents, and air-filled mastoid cells appear black and bubbly beside each ear. On the lateral face there is a small round ring-shaped bright bony structure on the image-left side and an elongated bright vertical bony structure on the image-right side, with gray soft tissue around both. The white letter "A" is at the upper left. No arrow, circle, scale bar, laterality marker, window setting or text overlay is visible. On the image-right side the gray soft tissue forms an asymmetric, rounded, bulging region surrounding the vertical bony structure and extending laterally toward the cheek skin, larger than the soft tissue around the ring-shaped bone on the image-left; no arrow, outline or label marks it, and its nature is not stated by the image.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Grayscale axial slice with bone, air and soft-tissue density contrast

panels.general_description: High-power H&E-type field of large atypical cells with clear to pale cytoplasm in sheets.
panels.detailed_description: Hematoxylin-and-eosin-type pink and purple histology field at high power. Large polygonal and elongated cells with abundant pale-pink to clear cytoplasm, rounded to oval vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli form sheets and cords across the field; many cells have visible cell borders. A cluster of small dark round cells (lymphocyte-sized) lies at the upper center. Pink fibrous strands are at the left. A white box with the black letter "A" is at the upper left and a solid black scale bar spans the lower left (the caption states 100 μm).
